**Generate Buffers:** Create a Vertex Array Object (VAO) and a VBO.
Bind the VBO and upload the 8 vertices (6 floats each) with usage hint `GL_STATIC_DRAW`.
Set Attribute 0 to read from offset 0 with stride 24.
**Create Geometry Instance:** Instantiate the geometry object.
**Render:** Submit the shape to the render action.
